summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for nested operation execution tracking within instrumented workflows. It addresses call hierarchy preservation across decorated function nesting—a semantic capability not present in existing skills. Peer candidates (Claude API tracking, LLM event capture, trace shutdown) operate at different layers (API invocation, event instrumentation, lifecycle management) and do not subsume nested call graph tracking. Existing skills are unrelated Spring configuration tasks. No merge, split, or revision applies.
